name: Screenshot Bug Reporter - Ollama to Jira

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'gemma3:latest', stream: false, format: 'json', prompt: 'Analyze this UI screenshot as a QA engineer. Return only valid JSON with title, summary, steps_to_reproduce, expected_result, actual_result, environment, severity, priority, labels, confidence, assumptions. Infer only what the screenshot supports. Reporter context: ' + ($json.context || 'None provided'), images: [$('Validate Screenshot').first().binary.screenshot.data] } }}

={{ { fields: { project: { key: $json.jiraProjectKey }, summary: $json.report.title, description: { type: 'doc', version: 1, content: [{ type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: $json.report.summary }] }, { type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Steps to reproduce: ' + $json.report.steps_to_reproduce.map((step, index) => (index + 1) + '. ' + step).join(' ') }] }, { type: 'paragraph', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Expected: ' + $json.report.expected_result + ' Actual: ' + $json.report.actual_result + ' Environment: ' + $json.report.environment }] }] }, issuetype: { name: $json.jiraIssueType }, labels: $json.report.labels } } }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, issueKey: $('Prepare Jira Attachment').first().json.issueKey, issueUrl: ($('Validate Jira Configuration').first().json.jiraBaseUrl + '/browse/' + $('Prepare Jira Attachment').first().json.issueKey), attachment: true } }}
